Old Mr. Bunny and his son
Old Mrs. Rabbit and Peter
Mr. McGregor and his cat

questions.q: What was Peter wearing when Benjamin found him?
choices: His blue coat and his little shoes
A red cotton pocket-handkerchief
An old tam-o'-shanter hat on his head
A pair of rabbit-wool mittens

choices: Squeeze under the gate
Dig a hole under the wall
Climb down a pear-tree
Jump over the cabbages

Water in the shoes and the coat had shrunk
Birds had made a nest inside the old shoes
The shoes were full of mud and little stones

Scared, and he kept hearing noises
Sleepy, and he wanted to lie down

Called loudly for his father
Hid himself and Peter under a basket
Threw the onions at the cat

questions.q: How did old Mr. Bunny get rid of the cat?
choices: He chased it right out of the garden gate
He jumped on it and kicked it into the greenhouse
He gave it the onions and it ran far away
He called for Mr. McGregor to come and take it away

questions.q: What is this story mostly about?
choices: Peter and Benjamin getting Peter's clothes back from the garden
Mrs. Rabbit selling her mittens at a busy bazaar
Mr. McGregor going for a long ride in his gig
The mice cracking cherry-stones on their doorsteps
